title: Section formula for the left ordinary direct-evaluation composite
statement: Let $l$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_l$ a finite extension, $A_k=\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak m_E^{k+1}$, $g:Z\to Y$, and $n\le m$. Let $P_g$ be native sequence-site module pushforward [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], $e_k$ coefficient evaluation, $c_k:P_g;e_k^Y\cong e_k^Z;g_*^{A_k}$ the composite of moduleEvalP and compactSupportDirectModel [lem-weil-compact-support-ordinary-direct-evaluation-sections], and $\tau^W_{m,n}$ the horizontal coefficient transition [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition]. For any sequence module $M$, object $V$ of $Y_{proet}$, and section $x$ of $e_m^Y(P_gM)$ over $V$, put $W=g^{-1}V$. Let $a_q$ be the identity-on-sections direct-image scalar comparison [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars], where $q:A_m\to A_n$ is the specified quotient. Then the section $a_q(\operatorname{Res}_q(c_n)(\tau^Y_{m,n,P_gM}(x)))$ is heterogeneously equal to $M((n,W)\to(m,W))(x)$. No cartesianness, flatness, or properness assumption is needed; equal coefficient levels are included.

source.place: Tags 03DI and 0D6E; left half of the ordinary section calculation.

proof.text: The ordinary scalar direct-image comparison is identity on section carriers by its unique normalization. Restriction of scalars preserves underlying maps. Ordinary direct evaluation is identity on sections by [lem-weil-compact-support-ordinary-direct-evaluation-sections]. The remaining horizontal coefficient transformation is restriction along the horizontal product arrow by [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition]. The native pushforward applies the product base-change functor to this arrow, preserving its coefficient index and its identity second component. The section is therefore the asserted horizontal restriction of M. Compose these heterogeneous section identities.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportOrdinaryDirectLeftSections
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (M : coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E Z) (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y m).obj
      ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.push (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) g).obj M)).val.obj V) :
    HEq (((proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison g
        (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).hom.app
          ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Z n).obj M)).val.app V
      (((proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).map
        ((compactSupportOrdinaryDirectEvaluation l E g n).hom.app M)).val.app V
          (((compactSupportOrdinaryCoefficientTransition l E Y h).app
            ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.push (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
              (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) g).obj M)).val.app V x)))
      (M.val.map (Prod.mkHom (homOfLE h)
        (𝟙 ((proEtaleBaseChange g).op.obj V).unop)).op x)
